title: MEIKO — What I Need To Do〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What if I asked for us to meet and talk once more?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What if I said that I still want us to be friends?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Is me just thinking that only going to hurt Mizuki even more...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Whatever the case, seeing Mizuki comes first...)
MEIKO...
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Can I help you?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You seem to have been keeping an eye on Mizuki for quite a while now...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The others are apparently buying into the whole “I'm busy” excuse, but I feel that you're not so convinced.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm not...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What happened...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I don't know for certain.
But...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Based on Ena's recent behavior, she appears to have learned about something Mizuki's been keeping a secret in a rather unfortunate way.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Which caused Mizuki to...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Run away.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Ugh.
This is what happens when you leave things up in the air.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I disagree.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: First, I don't even know what Mizuki was hiding.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But it's clear that it's related to something Mizuki was struggling with even before they all met.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: To Mizuki, this is a very big deal.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Something like this obviously requires a lot of time to understand and resolve.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But it seems that a little too much time has passed.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Even if you were to find the solution to a problem, if it's not accompanied by the right actions and results...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: This problem will go forever unsolved.
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, are you two fighting again...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Stay out of this.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You were talking about Mizuki, yes?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Kanade said that Mizuki's been too busy to visit, but is that really true?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's rather sharp of you.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I just happened to spot you talking to Ena when she was here.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And you've tried going over to see Mizuki a number of times, no?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Which is why I'm having a hard time understanding what “being too busy to visit” actually means.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Did you tell Miku and the others this...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: No.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I felt that I needed to be careful with this information. I mean, even KAITO's been walking on eggshells.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Then, why did you decide to blow your cover now?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Because asking directly was the quickest way to have my questions answered.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Also, you can't hide what's going on forever.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I know.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Kanade and Mafuyu still believe what Mizuki said, but they'll start worrying more and more as time goes on.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That also applies to Miku and the others.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: They're pure at heart, but they're not fools. They'll start wondering sooner or later.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, what do you plan on doing?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Let's say you do reach Mizuki.
The hard part comes right after that.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I want to see where their feelings take them.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Where their feelings take them?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I want Ena to find Mizuki and for them to talk.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So that Mizuki gets to hear how she really feels.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Which is why...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: If there's a role for me to play, it's to make sure Mizuki hears what Ena has to say.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And I plan on being there for them when that time comes.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Sounds like you've already found your answer, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I have.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (She might only have a tiny window, but I believe Ena will be able to capitalize on that chance.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (And I want to be there to make it happen.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (So Mizuki can hear what Ena has to say.)
